questions.prompt: Evaluate the integral from 0 to 2 of x^2 dx using the Fundamental Theorem.
hints: FTC: find antiderivative, evaluate at bounds.

questions.prompt: If F(x) = integral from 0 to x of t^2 dt, find F'(x).
hints: FTC Part 1: derivative of integral equals integrand.

questions.prompt: Evaluate the integral from 0 to 1 of 3x^2 dx.
Find d/dx of integral from 1 to x^2 of sin t dt.
hints: Chain rule: derivative of upper bound times integrand at upper bound.

questions.prompt: Evaluate the integral from 0 to 1 of e^x dx.
If F(x) = integral from 0 to x of cos t dt, find F(pi/2).
hints: FTC: sin(x) evaluated from 0 to pi/2.

questions.prompt: Find d/dx of integral from x to 1 of sqrt(t) dt.
hints: Swap limits to make lower variable: negative integral from 1 to x.

questions.prompt: Evaluate the integral from 0 to 4 of (2x - 1) dx.
Find the average value of f(x) = x on [0, 2].
hints: Average value = (1/(b-a)) times integral from a to b.

questions.prompt: If F'(x) = 1/x and F(1) = 0, find F(e).
hints: F(x) = ln x + C, F(1) = 0 gives C = 0.
